scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained after the established poly-Bernoulli enumeration identity; exact computations are independently reproducible. No independent expert validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to binary three-column lonesum counts and the prime eleven. Residue descriptions are proved for every prime-power level; the checker covers only levels one through five. Historical priority remains subject to possible implicit broader theorems.
title: Exact eleven-adic fibers of three-column lonesum matrices
